question: $P$ is a variable point on a circle $C$ and $Q$ is a fixed point on the outside of $C$. $R$ is a point in $PQ$ dividing it in the ratio $p:q$, where $p>0$ and $q>0$ are fixed. Then the locus of $R$ is

options.C: a circle if $p=q$ and an ellipse otherwise;

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
